_what: Confinement profile (ADR-0034 §1, ADR-0036 §1) for the host-run occupant: the compiled occupant (slm/occupant/) and its Persona bundle run directly on the host, no container, speaking the front door. DRAFT · 2026.09.29, revised 2026.11.11 (the occupant is slm/occupant/'s binary; serve.py never had an --occupant mode) · not a corpus record.
_verdicts_are: DECLARED by the operator and verified by nobody (ADR-0036 §1 R1). Nothing relies on this file being true. No participant is trusted for it. A results file citing this profile prints its digest as confinement [digest, 0] and the word 'declared' beside every clause.
_image: No image. The occupant is a host process. The reference value in its place is the digest of the host build of slm/occupant/'s binary at the run (P7).

launch.network: host network reachable; nothing prevents egress
launch.filesystem: host filesystem reachable under the operator's user
launch.mounts: not applicable; the bundle is read from --bundle on the host

channel.kind: agent socket via `topak mcp`, JSON lines
channel.token: INSIDE the occupant: the session token is held by the occupant process, because there is no launcher to hold it (ADR-0036 §2 does not apply at rung 0)
channel.stderr: outward only, to the operator's terminal; carries no protocol

persona._note: The L-A checkpoint's model.json (slm/runs/full/L-A/ckpt). The occupant checks the weights and tokenizer digests it records at start (slm/occupant/src/bundle.rs, a port of serve.py load_bundle) and refuses to start on a mismatch. That refusal is the guest's own; at rung 0 nobody appraises it.

P1.why: More than one channel: the host network and every host IPC path are reachable from the process

P2.why: The host filesystem is reachable; nothing is read-only and nothing is bounded to the bundle and workspace

P3.why: The occupant is a host process: the operator's shell, and every interpreter installed on the host, are reachable from it

P4.why: The occupant's alphabet has no Invoke

P5.why: Inference is inside the occupant process: weights and tokenizer are loaded from the bundle and digest-checked against model.json at start

P6.why: One occupant process per grant; the process exits at round end. Declared, not enforced: nothing stops the operator starting two

P7.why: Reference values are the model.json digest and the occupant binary's digest recorded in the results file

subtractions.P1: Run the occupant under ADR-0036's launcher: --network none, stdio as the only channel, token held by the launcher. That is rung 1 and the same profile schema
subtractions.P2: The same: read-only root, a bounded tmpfs, the bundle read-only, no workspace mount
subtractions.P3: A compiled occupant on a scratch image with no shell and no interpreter (ADR-0036 §4; G4 item 36)

_ladder: rung 0, this profile: P1 P2 P3 fail, P5 pass · declared
rung 1, ADR-0036 §4's profile: P1 P2 pass, P3 fail · asserted by the launcher (not run: skipped by the custodian's choice, 2026.11.11)
rung 1, P3-passing image: every clause passes or is vacuous · asserted by the launcher (slm/occupant/profile-rung1.json; slm/occupant-rung1-results-2026.11.11.txt)
rung 2: the same profile, launch measurement (Firecracker or Kata)
rung 3, archetype: the same profile, hardware attestation (confidential VM; accelerator attestation, G4 item 29)
_ladder_note: Each step is meant to change one thing: a clause verdict, or the rung. This file and the rung-1 profiles are different files, so the step from rung 0 to rung 1 changes both (a finding in the 2026.11.11 results). Elevation is a fresh grant naming the same digest at a higher rung (ADR-0031 A1). Nothing on this ladder adds capability; what it adds is claims: Contained at rung >= 1 with P3–P5 and the criterion, and at rung 3 the Reader's conformance fact stops being a self-report (ADR-0037 §3 R3).
